title: Dauntless Unbroken
description: Maintenance, account information, recent changes and issues still being investigated. Update your launcher and fully restart the game to load client fixes.

sections.title: Welcome to 1.10.5
sections.description: EU2 is in maintenance while updates are tested. Access is temporarily limited to the approved test accounts. Use your existing Unbroken account key when access resumes.

list: Launcher 1.0.56 is available. Update the launcher and fully restart the game before testing client changes.
Game downloads support resuming and file verification.
Ramsgate, Training Grounds and Hunting Grounds are available during normal operation; access is restricted during maintenance.

sections.title: Accounts and cosmetics
sections.description: Existing accounts carry their inventory and progression into the new realm. Migration changes are being checked during maintenance.

list: Legacy cosmetic records are converted to the item format used by 1.10.5 when inventory loads. Recovery records are kept.
Legacy Rams migration has been updated to combine supported old balances into the 1.10.5 inventory balance.
Missing weapon experience tracks on existing imports can be restored without overwriting existing progress.
Main-shop cosmetic offers use Rams; the displayed price is checked again when purchasing. Recruit dye stays in the shop for its quest; other offers rotate weekly.
Middleman fusion recipes take one hour. Existing timers are not restarted.

sections.title: Reliability fixes
sections.description: These changes are included in the update being tested during maintenance. A code change alone does not confirm every in-game case.

list: Launcher updates include game-file verification before play, friend-presence connection changes and improved language selection.
Reforge and weapon XP changes allow the level-20 reset and full weapon XP grants. All seven prestige tracks award Aetherhearts on subsequent reforges.
Party hunt routing and server readiness handling have been updated. Full Escalation runs and return travel still need multiplayer checks.
Ordinary bounties no longer overwrite seasonal challenge slots. Daily and weekly challenge state and tuning have been updated.
Bounty claim handling has been updated to grant native reward items once; in-game claims still need verification.
Slayer Link reward pools accept Combat Merits and Aethersparks; missing pools can be restored without resetting link progress.

sections.title: Issues under investigation
sections.description: After a problem, use launcher Settings > Help > Export to admins. Include the hunt, item or ability name and what happened.

list: Hunt timeouts, Escalation cancellations, full rounds and party return travel still need multiplayer verification.
Weapon meters, Thrax and chain-blade recovery, consumables, projectile damage and corruption-related zero-health states remain under investigation.
Omnicell visibility and activation, Radiant Escalation effects and Lightbound Koshai bubbles still need validation.
Missing cosmetics, bounty rewards, Trials and island unlocks, and Slayer Link reward display are being checked.
Daily and weekly challenge completion, refresh and reward claims still need end-to-end in-game verification.
Please report any reforge that charges currency without resetting weapon XP or updating its Slayer's Path requirement.
